MORGAN STANLEY $MS IS WEIGHING A $1.3 BILLION OFFICE TOWER IN DALLAS

709,000 square feet. 4,800 jobs by 2039. A 16-year lease starting in 2031.

The Wall Street migration to Texas is accelerating fast:

- Goldman Sachs: $500M campus, 5,000 employees, opening 2028
- Bank of America: anchoring a new tower in Uptown Dallas
- Morgan Stanley: $1.3B tower, up to 4,800 jobs by 2039
- Apollo Global: leaning toward Austin for its second US headquarters

Dallas is offering Morgan Stanley up to $18.5 million in economic development grants and a 90% tax abatement on business personal property for 10 years to make it happen.

Morgan Stanley says it is also considering Alpharetta, Georgia, so the deal is not finalized.

(Source Bloomberg)
A $7 billion private credit fund run by Morgan Stanley is capping investor withdrawals at 5%, allowing less than half of the redemptions shareholders requested in the second quarter.
